title: Drinking-Water Handling and Basic Safety Precautions
sourceName: Concise Handbook for Monitoring Water Quality of Piped Drinking Water Supply to Rural Households
publisher: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
summary: The Jal Jeevan Mission handbook identifies monitoring and maintaining the quality of piped water supply as crucial components of safe water supply to rural households.

sections.heading: Water-quality monitoring
sections.content: The handbook describes water-quality monitoring from the source through treatment and delivery points for piped drinking-water supply.

sections.heading: Scope limitation
sections.content: This document provides general information about water-quality monitoring. It does not provide medical advice or household water-treatment instructions.

scope: General water-quality monitoring information for piped rural supply only; no medical advice or household water-treatment instructions.
verificationNotes: Reviewed against the National Jal Jeevan Mission handbook on 2026-08-08.
